fusions.name: Scratched-Up Dirt
fusions.desc: Scratches dirt back through a cone 3 tiles long, dealing 3 damage to everything in it with a 25% chance to leave each [Blunted] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Gizzard Stone
fusions.desc: Coughs up a swallowed stone and spits it at the first enemy in line for 28 damage. It bursts on impact, dealing 80% of that to every enemy within 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Dust Bath
fusions.desc: For 3 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you.

fusions.name: Grit Spurs
fusions.desc: Conjures spurs of jagged rock on your heels: your weapon damage rises by 12% and your attack speed by 5%, and every strike leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a tick for 2 ticks.
